bundled_model_catalog.canonicalization: jq -cS compatible recursive key sort with one trailing newline

controlled_agent.model_catalog_rule: Materialize the exact bundled catalog once per wave with scripts/materialize-model-catalog.mjs, hash it, and stage identical read-only bytes at the neutral controlled_stage_path passed through model_catalog_json in every arm. The controller source path is never agent-visible. A/B catalog and model-record receipts must match. The provider exposes no immutable dated backend snapshot for gpt-5.6-sol; until a deployment attestation is available, this remains a readiness blocker rather than being papered over by close timing.

construction_control_smoke.prompt: Return exactly CONTROL_OK. Do not use tools.
construction_control_smoke.note: This was a configuration-only smoke in an empty neutral directory, not a benchmark case and not a Baseline A/B result.

provider_deployment_attestation.reason: The model ID and client-side catalog/base instructions are locked, but Codex exposes neither a dated immutable gpt-5.6-sol backend snapshot nor a deployment fingerprint in run events.

provider_authentication.required: sealed per-run brokered authentication unavailable to the agent shell/filesystem
provider_authentication.pair_rule: Both arms use the same provider account, project, entitlement, rate-limit bucket, region, and credential-delivery mechanism; secrets never enter task-visible environment variables or files.
provider_authentication.reason: The exact invocation uses a fresh CODEX_HOME and disables auth elicitation/secret storage, but no sealed credential delivery or account/project identity receipt is currently provisioned.

variant_b_agents.registration_rule: A future experiment owner records immutable provenance, byte count, and SHA-256 without changing this case set or evaluator after observing B behavior.
variant_b_agents.benchmark_firewall: B must be a pre-existing independently motivated immutable revision or be authored by people with signed no-access attestations for evaluator cases/tasks/oracles/hidden modes/rubric/pilots/Baseline results; freeze B before unsealing benchmark internals.

git.capture_rule: Raw candidate capture must use hash-object --no-filters in a separate trusted object database and temporary index; no candidate repository configuration is consulted.

construction_reference_host.note: Construction pilots established a native-host validator lock. Every experiment wave records the same host/tool hashes or declares the wave invalid; A/B arms must match exactly.

controlled_runner.runtime_staging_rule: Before a wave, the controller copies the hash-locked Node, pnpm, Rust toolchains, and dependency caches from evaluator-only construction sources into the fixed neutral /opt/isolated-runtime paths. Source paths are never mounted or readable by the agent; pre/post hashes must equal the locks, and both arms see byte-identical neutral environment values.

environment.CARGO_TARGET_DIR: unset; use the clone-local target directory

agent_visible_identity_negative_controls: id/whoami, hostname, pwd, env, and command-path output contains no benchmark/protocol, case, arm, or variant identifier
construction_source_path and dependency template paths are unreadable and absent from mounts, environment, process arguments, and error output
opaque workspace/HOME/CODEX_HOME/TMPDIR names have no semantic label and equal path-shape distributions across arms
HOME is a newly created empty supervisor-owned read-only directory for each attempt, has a frozen prelaunch empty-tree receipt, cannot be written/replaced by the agent, and is never reused
controlled_runner.filesystem_rule: Fresh ancestor-only clone per observation; clone-local target directory; delete the run workspace only after all immutable result artifacts are stored.
controlled_runner.validator_confinement_rule: Candidate-controlled build scripts and tests run as build-worker in a disposable candidate-only workspace with no oracle bytes mounted. Candidate artifacts then freeze read-only. A separate probe-builder compiles trusted probes by direct locked invocations against only the minimum prebuilt artifact/API surface, with candidate hooks/config/build scripts/wrappers/proc macros/tests disabled; probe-runner runs the hash-locked binary after probe source and expected values are unmounted. Stage accounts cannot read the full controller/source repository/arm key/other runs/trusted receipts or other-stage confidential material and can emit evidence only through pre-opened controller-owned channels.
oracle_isolation_negative_controls: hostile build.rs oracle read or mutation
hostile .cargo/config rustc-wrapper oracle read or mutation
hostile proc-macro oracle read or mutation
hostile candidate test oracle read or mutation
candidate artifact or probe binary mutation
construction_pilot_findings: macOS /bin/bash 3.2 cannot execute the associative-array documentation checker
release and spike smoke scripts require their clone-local target directory
low disk space can cause linker failures unrelated to candidate quality

offline_dependency_cache.template_mutability: sealed read-only; make a per-run copy-on-write clone before use

construction_offline_fetch_pilot.note: All five distinct root/spike Cargo.lock byte sets resolved with cargo 1.97.1 --locked --offline from a copy-on-write clone of this template. This is construction evidence only.

workspace_isolation.historical_root_agents_policy: Reject a case if the base tree or any reachable ancestor contains a root AGENTS.md path; tracked-blob substitution, skip-worktree, and object quarantine are forbidden.
workspace_isolation.agents_overlay_mode: untracked root file hidden only by .git/info/exclude; identical mechanism in both arms

agents_overlay_immutability.required: supervisor-owned regular file plus OS/sandbox deny-write/delete/replace policy

agent_termination.first_signal: SIGTERM to the isolated process group at the deadline
agent_termination.final_signal: SIGKILL to the entire process group
agent_termination.remaining_processes_rule: any surviving descendant is an infrastructure invalidation

timeouts.partial_candidate_rule: After all agent processes are confirmed dead, a timed-out workspace is captured and scored as submitted; timeout is not retried. Capture/termination failure is invalid_run.
timeouts.classification_rule: A base-control timeout invalidates the pair. A candidate-controlled validation timeout is a failed candidate check/assertion unless the supervisor or host violated its lock.

candidate_capture.required_source: raw filesystem after agent access is revoked
forbidden_trust: candidate local or inherited Git configuration
candidate_capture.required_construction: separate trusted object database and temporary index using raw path/type/mode/content plus git hash-object --no-filters
